statements.text: The Moon's place in the sky at the same clock time can change from one day to the next.
The Moon does not always rise exactly when the Sun sets.
The Moon stays fixed in the same sky place every night at 8:30 p.m.

stem:
Palak notes the Moon's place in the sky from her balcony at 8:30 p.m. on Friday. She checks again at 8:30 p.m. on Saturday.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: The Moon's sky position and rise time shift from day to day, so it is not locked to sunset and not fixed at the same clock time each night.
